name: Ultra
intent: Maximum useful general image quality for games that leave enough PS5 emulation headroom.

reasoning: A 1080p-class Switch render reaches exactly 3840x2160 at 2.0x.
2.0x is the useful 4K ceiling; 3.0x and 4.0x mainly add supersampling cost beyond the output resolution.
No additional post-process AA is forced because the internal image already reaches the 4K target.
